author: Joop_
body:
Hello,

Over the past years I've played on a similar server like the Avicus Network. I loved the gamemodes on that server, but the server has to close in a few weeks. The Avicus Network offers the same kind of awesome gamemodes and I would like to make the switch to this network.

I am sorry for stating wrong things in the chat, I should have read the rulesset first. I am offering my apologies to everyone that I have insulted with the ads.

I would like to be a proud member of this server. Please consider giving me a second chance.

Yours sincerely,

Joop.

replies.body:
Hello,

Since you are aware of what you did wrong and it seems like you're ready to change after being given another chance, I've decided to appeal your infraction.
For future reference, please read through the rules.

Regards,
Neyke
